title: eval-harness: add per-prompt CI hook + thresholded quality gating for prompt regression
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Add per-prompt regression CI hook and threshold-based quality gating for eval-harness; improves detection of prompt-level regressions in PRs. Backwards compatible with existing eval workflows.
description:
Motivation: We frequently see regressions that only affect a small subset of prompts. Current CI gates run aggregate evals which can miss small but user-facing regressions. This PR adds a per-prompt CI hook that computes per-prompt metrics and fails the job when a configured prompt-level delta or quality threshold is violated.

What this changes: - Introduce a new eval-harness CI hook (scripts/eval_ci/per_prompt_hook.py) that runs selected prompt sets and emits per-prompt metrics to the CI runner. - Add threshold config (eval_harness/config/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml) that lets teams opt-in per-prompt deltas and absolute quality floors. - Integrate the hook into circleci and github actions workflows (ci/eval-harness.yml) as an optional job that annotates PRs with a summary and failing prompts. - Add dashboard-friendly metric labels so alerts and historical traces show prompt-level regressions.

Checklist: - [x] Implement per-prompt runner and JSON output schema - [x] Wire thresholds and opt-in config - [x] Add PR annotation logic (checks API) - [x] Add unit tests and an integration smoke test that exercises a small prompt set - [x] Update README and quickstart docs with opt-in instructions

Backward compatibility and opt-in: The new hook is opt-in by default (disabled for repos that haven't added per_prompt_thresholds.yaml). Teams can enable per-prompt gating per repo or route by adding a small config file. This keeps the default aggregate gating unchanged.

Telemetry and CI UX: When the hook runs it uploads a small per-prompt summary file to the CI artifact store and posts a compact summary as a GitHub check. The check contains a table of failing prompts with metric deltas and links to the full eval artifact.

Related: ENG-4821 (per-prompt regression detection), ENG-4899 (eval CI improvements), SUP-7421 (customer report of a prompt-only regression in production).

Priya Shah: Tests look good, but the GitHub check annotation is a little verbose for >100 failing prompts. Could we collapse into top-10 by delta and provide an artifact link for the full list?
Aisha Khan: Updated annotation to show top 10 failing prompts by metric delta and include direct link to the artifact. Also added pagination-friendly JSON artifact format.
